notes.title: Release date moved to first half of 2026!
notes.notes:
Hello Elders,



Ok first thing's first, we will need to move game release back to first half of 2026, there is a lot of things we still want to do, and a lot of polish that we feel that this game needs so all of you can have a nice and smooth game experience.



There are few major areas that we are focusing on

more content

a game that can run on 10 year old PCs (yes you heard correctly) - we still have some work to do here but idea is to optimize the game as much as possible while keeping highest possible GFX settings

UI polish



We also had a very small closed alpha, which went very well!



Keep applying for playtest as we will be having more of those happening usually on weekends and letting more people in. They will become more and more public up to the major huge playtest with more then few thousands players who have already applied!



To apply for playtest simply click below > "Request Access" on the main store page



Also Kickstarter is going up soon, don't miss it :)

Kickstarter



And some figurines ideas that might be in the works? How would you feel about owning those units?
